subject: AP channel preference: portal opt-in with SFTP fallback and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Liam Reilly <liam.reilly@greenlane.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-11-22T08:12:00Z
Subject: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenLane

Hi Hannah,

Quick one from AP at GreenLane — we need to confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices going forward. Our AP team prefers portal delivery to ingest invoices automatically, but we still need an email copy to accounts-payable@greenlane.com for internal routing.

A few specifics we need to confirm:
- Can you push invoices to a portal (enrollment link / API)?
- If we opt for email copies, can you include structured XML (or have an XML attachment) for automated ingestion?
- We operate entities across the UK and IE — we need clear VAT fields on invoices and separate VAT evidence for reverse-charge scenarios.
- As a fallback, we may require signed PDF transmission via SFTP for our legacy systems. Is that supported?

Attached is our PO (greenlane-po-8893.pdf). Please confirm next steps and a rough timeline for onboarding.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Reilly
AP Manager — GreenLane Logistics
accounts-payable@greenlane.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Reilly <liam.reilly@greenlane.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-11-22T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenLane

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear note and the PO.

Short answers up front:
- Yes — we prefer to onboard customers to the Redwood Billing Portal (portal push + API) as the canonical delivery method.
- We can send an email copy to accounts-payable@greenlane.com on invoice emission.
- We support attaching a structured XML payload alongside the PDF (we've attached an invoice-xml-sample.xml for your AP team to review).
- We can provide separate VAT-evidence attachments (CSV or PDF) for reverse-charge cases, or tag VAT fields in the XML if you prefer a single payload.
- SFTP for signed PDFs is supported as a fallback; we'll need host/key details and an exchange of SSH keys.

Next steps I propose:
1) Portal enrollment (preferred): we send an invite and a short onboarding checklist — Connor will run the technical setup.
2) If you need SFTP, please share host, user, and the contact for key exchange; we'll queue that as a fallback path.
3) Confirm which legal entity(ies) will receive each invoice (we saw PO 8893 — please confirm remit-to and VAT number per entity).

I've attached a sample invoice PDF and an XML example so your AP can validate mapping. Kimberly (cc) is on legal/compliance and will confirm required VAT fields if there are reverse-charge complications.

Timeline: once we have entity/VAT details and portal enroll acceptance, typical turn-up is 3-5 business days to enable portal + email copies; SFTP onboarding can run in parallel but may take up to 7 business days depending on key exchange windows.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Liam Reilly <liam.reilly@greenlane.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@greenlane.com
Date: 2028-11-22T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenLane

Thanks Hannah — that's helpful.

Confirming:
- We will enroll in the portal (please send invite).
- We still need an email copy to accounts-payable@greenlane.com as a mirror.
- For XML: please include a VATNumber field and a ReverseCharge boolean (if present).
- GreenLane VAT numbers by entity: GB123456789 (UK entity), IE9876543V (Ireland entity).
- Remit-to: same as PO; include bank details on the invoice footer.

We'd like SFTP as a fallback for signed PDFs — I've attached the PO again (greenlane-po-8893.pdf) and will loop in our infra team if you need a contact for key exchange.

If you can send the portal invite and the onboarding checklist, we'll prioritize completing that this week.

Regards,
Liam
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Reilly <liam.reilly@greenlane.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-11-22T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence for GreenLane

Hi Liam — quick compliance note from Legal/Tax:

Please ensure the invoice payload includes the following fields for EU moves:
- Supplier VAT Registration Number
- Customer VAT Registration Number (VATNumber as requested)
- TaxableCountry (two-letter code)
- TaxRate and TaxAmount per line item
- ReverseChargeIndicator (true/false)
- If reverse charge applies, an explicit statement line citing the legal basis (we can provide text).

We can add VAT evidence as a separate PDF or include a machine-readable JSON/CSV attachment. For multi-entity customers, please confirm which VAT number applies to each invoice by referencing the invoice 'BillTo' entity.

Connor — please coordinate portal invite + SFTP key instructions with Liam; Hannah noted timelines.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Reilly <liam.reilly@greenlane.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-22T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Portal invite & SFTP setup — GreenLane onboarding

Hi Liam — Connor here from Customer Onboarding (AP integration).

Portal invite: https://console.redwoodinference.com/portal-enroll/GL-8893 (live for 7 days). The checklist in the portal includes: billing contact, entity VAT numbers, sample PO (we have 8893), and preferred remittance instructions.

SFTP fallback: we support key-based auth. To proceed we need:
- Hostname and inbound user you want us to use
- Your public SSH key (openssh format) or a designated email for key exchange
- Preferred directory layout (we can drop invoices under /incoming/greenlane/)

Estimated timelines: portal enablement in 1-3 business days after you accept the invite and fill the form; SFTP key exchange + verification typically 3-7 business days.

I'll trigger the portal invite now and attach the onboarding checklist to the invite. If you want us to prioritize SFTP earlier, say the word and we'll front-load the infra work.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Thanks Connor — invite received and I've shared the checklist with AP and infra. We'll complete the portal form today and send the public SSH key if we decide to proceed with SFTP. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Liam
